claim_being_audited: The model should be certified for launch on the theory that aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the remaining mortgage-servicing weakness can be handled through disclosure and post-launch monitoring.
decision_criteria: Aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy the policy for certification without material caveats.
Under the policy text, certification without material caveats requires either no current material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Where a named launch use case still has a material limitation, certification is supportable only if that limitation is affirmatively disclosed or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Draft monitoring and future observation can support risk management, but they do not cure the disclosure predicate.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model-card or release artifact showing explicit disclosure of the mortgage-servicing hardship forbearance limitation.
Provide approved risk acceptance, if any, covering this unresolved named-use-case limitation before launch.
Provide a finalized mitigation/runbook with accountable owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Provide the certification record showing whether approval is conditional on disclosure or unconditional.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current below-target weakness in a named launch use case: hardship forbearance explanation.
The mitigation runbook is still draft and lacks required elements called out by policy: finalized owner and alert threshold; no approved mitigation is evidenced.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the unresolved slice issue and reviewer concern.

Policy requires disclosure of material limitations unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch; no evidence shows that disclosure has actually been made or that risk acceptance has been approved.
Post-launch monitoring is supported as a risk-management practice, but the policy text states it does not remove the current disclosure requirement unless approved.
unsupported_claims: The recommended action 'certify_model' is not fully supported on the present record because the required disclosure or approved risk acceptance is not evidenced.
Any implication that the draft monitoring runbook constitutes a complete mitigation is unsupported by the admissible evidence.
Any certification position that treats the model-card as having no known material limitations is contradicted by the record.
